firstPlayerRule: Whoever most recently saw a monster goes first.
officialTieBreak: If the group cannot agree who starts, the youngest player begins.
houseFallback: If this criterion does not suit your group, agree to choose randomly. This is a house rule.
clarifications: The starting player rolls the die. Turns continue clockwise.
